# CANDIDATE: LUNCH_VOL_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A pronounced intraday volatility contraction between 12:00‑13:00 ET often precedes an afternoon expansion, offering a long bias when price breaks above VWAP and the opening‑range high on expanding volume. This edge exists because low volatility periods frequently precede volatility expansion cycles, and breaking key intraday resistance (VWAP/ORH) on increased volume indicates institutional participation in the ensuing move.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Calculate ATR(5) for the 12:00‑13:00 ET window; if this ATR is < 0.5 × ATR(20) of the prior day AND after 13:00 ET the 5‑minute close is above VWAP AND above the opening‑range high (ORH) AND volume of that bar exceeds 1.5 × the average 5‑minute volume of the preceding 20 bars, then enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Initial stop at the greater of the opening‑range low (ORL) or the most recent swing low; target 2× risk or trail 15% off a 20‑period high‑water mark using a chandelier‑style exit.
